title: There's a Rat That's 37 Years Old
hook: A regular mouse lives 2 to 3 years, but this rat lives more than 37
summary: The naked mole-rat lives more than 37 years, and its chance of dying doesn't go up as it gets older.

text: Meet the naked mole-rat, which lives underground in East Africa.
It has almost no fur, and its front teeth stick right out.

panels.text: Kind of odd looking, but weirdly cute

text: A house mouse lives about 2 to 3 years, even with good care.
But this rat has been recorded living more than 37 years.

panels.mean: the longest lifespan on record for a rodent

text: What's even stranger is how it ages.
the chance of dying keeps going up with age.
Its chance of dying doesn't go up as it gets older.

panels.text: Wait, so it doesn't get old?

text: It's a stretch to say it doesn't get old,
but at least being older doesn't put it at more risk.
Scientists are studying it to find the secret to its long life.
The way they live is unusual too.
Like ants or bees, one queen has all the babies,
and the rest are split into workers and soldiers.

panels.text: Guess we shouldn't make fun of it for being ugly
